title: Routed dual BiLSTM toxicity classifier
summary: Comments are lowercased, regex-tokenized, head-truncated to 192 tokens, and mapped to a training-only frequency-capped vocabulary with padding and unknown tokens. Each specialist uses learned 256-dimensional embeddings, spatial embedding dropout, two bidirectional LSTM layers, masked mean/max pooling, two residual ReLU dense layers, and a logit head. One specialist minimizes fractional binary cross-entropy; the other adds a batchwise penalty that equalizes mean predicted probabilities between identity-present and identity-absent examples within each hard toxicity class. Both train on a 95% fitting split using length-bucketed batches, AdamW, warmup-cosine learning rates, fp16 gradient scaling, and gradient clipping. A held-out 5% training split trains a router from both logits, their disagreement, probabilities, and length. Its sigmoid gate blends frozen specialist logits and is optimized with BCE, sampled slice-wise pairwise ranking loss, and an anchor penalty. Validation probabilities are sigmoid-transformed routed logits.
